title: Pharaoh's soul guided through seven palaces in the Pyramid Texts

tellings.quote: If we go back even further to the oldest religious texts we have, the ancient Egyptian pyramid texts from 2400 BC, we see the pharaoh's soul is guided by the priests through the seven areet, also called, you guessed it, palaces.

plain: In the Pyramid Texts, the ancient Egyptian religious writings that Michels dates to 2400 BC, the pharaoh's soul is guided by priests through seven 'areet', a word Michels says also means palaces. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source. He offers it as the oldest example of a pattern of seven palaces that he follows through later religious texts.
